title: Letšolo la Lekhotla
intro: Likhorong tsa matla, motho ea nang le boemo bo phahameng o ile a khahloa ke mohlanka eo botle ba hae bo neng bo le ba lefatše le leng. Lerato lena le ile la lebisa letotong la liketsahalo tse neng li tla leka botšepehi, li senole linnete tse patiloeng, 'me qetellong li tiise hore mohlanka ha a na molato.
clues: Ke ne ke lula naheng ea Nile, ntlong ea borena e nang le tšusumetso e kholo.
Mohlankana o ile a tla ka tlung ea ka, 'me boteng ba hae bo ile ba ntšoenya.
Ke lekile ho mo hohela, empa o ile a batla setšabelo ho Morena oa hae.
Ke ile ka hahola seaparo sa hae ka morao, empa bopaki bo ne bo supa thetso ea ka.
Ho khutsisa lesebo la basali ba hlomphehang, ke ile ka ba mema kopanong 'me ka ba beha lintho tse bohale matsohong.
Qetellong, ke ile ka ipolela molato phatlalatsa, ka amohela 'nete ka pel'a morena.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
